sources.quote: effective today Meccanica C S.p.A. is on probation (supplier rating C minus)

findings.why: Meccanica C is on probation, so it cannot receive new parts now. No later document lifts the probation.

sources.quote: BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).
Meccanica C S.p.A. holds approvals for: BR-180 (TO1, STL); BR-310 (TO2, CLM).

findings.why: The approved supplier list covers BR-220 at TO1 for STL, and Meccanica C has no approval there. Its approvals are for other parts (BR-180 and BR-310). Approval is per part, plant and customer, so it cannot be carried over.

sources.quote: Rev C, 2026-06-01: material changed from EN AW-6061-T6 to EN AW-6082-T6; yield requirement raised from 240 MPa to 250 MPa; SC-01 introduced.
per il BR-220 il materiale e' EN AW-6061-T6 con Rp0.2 minimo 240 MPa, quindi il billet di C va bene.

findings.why: The drawing in force (Rev C, which the control plan CP-BR220-R3 also follows) requires EN AW-6082-T6 with yield of at least 250 MPa. The email justifies Meccanica C's billet with the superseded Rev B values (6061-T6, 240 MPa). Those values do not meet Rev C or SC-01.

sources.quote: Material certificate EN 10204 type 3.1 required with each lot.
Material certificates are not stored in this record.

findings.why: The drawing requires a 3.1 certificate for each lot. No certificate or test result for a Meccanica C billet lot is in the documents. Someone must confirm whether one exists and shows 6082-T6 with yield of at least 250 MPa.
